scope: Independent source review of exactly two frozen C5 Swift test-only consumers for real S5 data handoff; no controller/source/canonical changes.

reviewedCallChain: Producer keeps existing real C5 public search/detail/TOC/two chapter read/cache claims, writes actual position and calls coldSubmit with that same BookStore/position owner.

coldSubmit calls existing Package.fixture (real Unpacker/Vault/SecKey/PackageSigner), retains a real ReaderNavigator registered in one handoff, adds source through normal BookSourceStore, and submits once through actual mTLS Peer -> Coordinator.submitWithAppDataHandoff.

Journal lives under run-owned data/renewal/SelfRenewalTransactions, outside temporary Package.fixture. Coordinator.close runs before fixture Vault/temporary cleanup. Candidate and transaction persist for second host; errors preserve primary and close error.
Consumer uses normal BookStore, normal BookSourceStore receipt and real checked position reads. Existing same container/run/book/source/PID/cache/offline sourceResolver=0 guards remain.

Consumer creates recoveryOnly with no Vault/peer/endpoint. observeUserDataAfterNormalLoad is the only operation; exact Record comparison permits only userDataRead/revision/updatedAt, requires revision+1/receiptObserved/selectedFilesMatch/no bootstrap.

Both hosts require installedMaterial nil, installedDifferentProcess explicit null and renewalVerified false. Actual candidate bytes/hash remain exact; no installed observation or automatic retirement is fabricated.
apiAndOwnershipEvidence: 11 frozen readonly reference files bound. MainActor ColdOwners retains sources/handoff/navigator; actual navigator init registers weakly and strong after-submit property read retains it through the hook.

Normal BookStore save uses existing queue and sorted full metadata; off-shelf record still produces [] shelf bytes. Consumer normal-load receipt comes from original reads, not a test-created observation.

Real JSONFileReadingPositionStore default checked IO is used with onSave no cloud side effect. loadChecked returns actual file bytes and semantic position. New helper disk reads are nonisolated/off-main and bounded.

Existing Package.fixture.make has throwing #require for its fixture prerequisites, not nonthrowing #expect success predicates. New helper assertions use thrown ColdFailure so XCTest cannot pass merely from SwiftTesting issue recording.
Journal/recovery APIs and case/field names match referenced current production definitions. No extra session, store, queue, VM or new test selector is introduced.
